CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Guest user is forced to login/register before wishlist actions
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: As logged-out user, attempt wishlist entry from header and add-to-wishlist from PDP. Complete login with both single-WL and multi-WL accounts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
User is redirected to authentication before wishlist mutation executes.
After successful login, user can continue the intended wishlist action in a valid context.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Single wishlist page renders expected product content and navigation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open wishlist for account with one wishlist and validate layout, product card details, and basic controls across desktop and mobile breakpoints.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Single wishlist view loads without layout regressions.
Product card information and controls are visible and actionable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Mini PDP reflects sold-out and unavailable states correctly
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open products with sold-out and unavailable variants and inspect Mini PDP CTAs and visual state treatment.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Sold-out and unavailable states show the correct CTA behavior.
Visual indicators match expected state without contradictory messaging.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Delete from wishlist removes item from visible list
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From wishlist list/grid view, delete an item and confirm list refresh and item absence.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Deleted item disappears from current wishlist list.
No broken card placeholders or stale counters remain.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Undo after delete restores item state
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Delete an item, trigger Undo notification, then re-check wishlist content and card state.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Undo restores the deleted item in the expected position/state.
No duplicate or inconsistent card state appears after undo.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Delete notification appears with meaningful message and action
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Delete item and verify notification copy, timing, and Undo action affordance.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
User receives immediate confirmation after delete.
Notification includes clear Undo action and dismisses predictably.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Wishlist empty state appears when no products remain
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Clear wishlist items or use empty account to load wishlist and inspect empty-state visuals and CTA links.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Empty state is displayed instead of broken list shell.
Empty state messaging and CTA allow user recovery path.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Skeleton/loading state is shown while wishlist data loads
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Throttle network or refresh wishlist entry and observe loading transition before content render.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Skeleton state appears during data fetch.
Skeleton is replaced by final content without stuck loading artifacts.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Product remains in wishlist after Add to Cart from wishlist context
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Add a wishlist product to cart and revisit wishlist list and item state afterward.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Item remains in wishlist after Add to Cart action.
Cart addition does not force unintended wishlist removal.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Core wishlist flows are consistent across desktop and mobile
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat login-gated add/delete/undo and empty-state checks on desktop and mobile breakpoints for NAP and MRP acceptance hosts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Critical flows work on both breakpoints without behavior regressions.
Brand surfaces preserve functional parity for covered scenarios.
